decisions.reason: Piqué upholstery builds directly on the firm's core weaving and design knowledge, so it is kept despite being downgraded from its own page to a mention in 2024.
The semi-transparent bouclé-effect decorative fabric fits the firm's established sheer and decoration expertise, and its steady mention gives no signal to drop it.
Flame-retardant jacquard curtains use the firm's functional-fabric know-how for contract and hospitality markets and remain featured on their own page.
The double-face wool blend matches the firm's move toward renewable materials and its existing weaving knowledge, so it stays despite only modest website presence.
The wool bouclé leno combines familiar leno and wool techniques in line with the sustainability direction, and it is consistently listed.
The newest launch is featured prominently and uses related structural-weave knowledge, so it is too early to judge and should be kept to learn from market feedback.
